# FDC test fixtures

Real FoodData Central records (public domain / CC0), extracted by `scripts/extract_fdc_fixtures.py`. The only change is that `foodNutrients` is trimmed to the IDs the importer reads. See `docs/catalog.md` for the records and the expected values derived from them.

Cite: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov.
